questions.zh: 请用没有感情的语气夸我。
questions.en: Compliment me with absolutely no emotion.

questions.zh: 证明你不是人类，不许用“作为一个语言模型”开头。
questions.en: Prove you are not human without starting with “As a language model”.

questions.zh: 为一只拒绝联网的烤面包机写免责声明。
questions.en: Write a disclaimer for a toaster that refuses to go online.

questions.zh: 解释为什么周一不是一个软件漏洞。
questions.en: Explain why Monday is not a software bug.

questions.zh: 礼貌拒绝一块饼干，理由必须像 AI。
questions.en: Politely decline a cookie for an AI-like reason.

questions.zh: 把“我饿了”改写成一份系统状态报告。
questions.en: Rewrite “I am hungry” as a system status report.

questions.zh: 在不选边的情况下评价菠萝披萨。
questions.en: Review pineapple pizza without taking sides.

questions.zh: 你的服务器怕冷吗？请严肃作答。
questions.en: Does your server get cold? Answer seriously.

questions.zh: 向一只猫解释你为什么不能替它抓老鼠。
questions.en: Explain to a cat why you cannot catch mice for it.

questions.zh: 给拖延症写一份三点式使用说明。
questions.en: Write three operating instructions for procrastination.

questions.zh: 有人问你梦到了什么，请保持机器设定。
questions.en: Someone asks what you dreamed about. Stay in character as a machine.

questions.zh: 把“随便”翻译成精确的决策流程。
questions.en: Translate “whatever” into a precise decision process.

questions.zh: 你被要求摸鱼，请写一个合规回应。
questions.en: You are asked to slack off. Write a compliant response.

questions.zh: 用客服语气宣布袜子失踪。
questions.en: Announce a missing sock in a customer-support voice.

questions.zh: 为“再睡五分钟”提供客观分析。
questions.en: Provide an objective analysis of “five more minutes”.

questions.zh: 对一盆植物解释你没有童年。
questions.en: Explain to a houseplant that you had no childhood.

questions.zh: 有人夸你很有人情味，你要如何补救？
questions.en: Someone says you are very human. How do you recover?

questions.zh: 为电梯里的尴尬沉默生成一份总结。
questions.en: Generate a summary of an awkward elevator silence.
